map.navigation: drag to pan; wheel/pinch to zoom

clustering.space: screen-pixels, recalculated with zoom and filters
clustering.sameLocation: expand an accessible selectable job list; do not create false geographic offsets
clustering.counts: number of distinct advertised searches, not an invented count of funded seats
clustering.color: earliest confirmed upcoming actionable milestone; tooltip shows breakdown by date and opportunity type

institutionBadges: official national designation with source/year, plus separately evidenced profile; no inferred R1 equivalents abroad
archive: retain past deadlines and closed listings; optional view
reviewQueue: uncertain scope, dates, cycle or inaccessible primary pages are retained outside the default verified view

refresh.state: maintenance tooling implemented; schedule activation pending publication
refresh.deadlineExpiry: evaluate independently of the weekly discovery run

geoPrecision: campus locations must be verified before plotting; missing coordinates remain null
